claims.claim: AutoGrow initiates training from a shallow seed network and adds layers only when the validation accuracy improves.
Layer growth ceases when additional depth no longer leads to accuracy gains under the learned policy.
The approach yields strong accuracy‑computation trade‑offs across several benchmark datasets.

summary: AutoGrow automatically discovers network depth by growing layers from a shallow seed when accuracy improves and stopping when further depth yields no benefit, achieving favorable accuracy‑compute trade‑offs on multiple datasets.
